title: Check a volunteer’s RSVP
summary: See whether a volunteer has responded to their serving assignment in Tithely.

steps.title: Open the Events calendar
paragraphs: Log in to Tithely and click “Events” in the top navigation. Tithely opens the calendar.

images.alt: Tithely dashboard with Events selected in the top navigation and the November calendar open.
images.caption: Click Events to open the calendar.

steps.title: Find and click the event
paragraphs: Use the arrows next to the month to navigate to the date you want to check. Click the event on that date. In this example, click the 10:30 a.m. Nursery event on January 31.

images.alt: January 2027 calendar with the 10:30 a.m. Nursery event on January 31.
images.caption: The example event is Nursery on January 31 at 10:30 a.m.

steps.title: Open Volunteers
paragraphs: In the event window, click “Volunteers” to open the list of people scheduled to serve.

images.alt: January 31 Nursery event window with the purple Volunteers button at the lower right.
images.caption: Volunteers is in the lower-right corner of the event window.

steps.title: Check the volunteer’s response
paragraphs: Find the volunteer under their assigned role and look at the circle beside their name.
A filled green circle means they accepted the assignment and RSVPed.
An empty circle means there’s no RSVP recorded. They may not have responded yet, or they may be missing an email address in the directory to receive the request.

images.alt: Nursery volunteer list with a filled green circle for an accepted RSVP and empty circles for assignments with no response.
images.caption: Read the RSVP circle beside each volunteer’s name.
